iQIBLA Life is a daily companion APP for the Muslims. Not only because it works with our smart products such as Zikr Ring and Qibla Watch, but as a stand-alone APP with prayer times, prayer directions and other features. It also allows you to treat Allah with the utmost devotion at all times.






**Prayer Times**



The wise Creator has appointed a number of worships for Muslims. Obligations such as prayers, fasting and Hajj are clearly timed." For such prayers are enjoined on believers at stated times" declares that the five daily prayers must be performed at their correct times. Performing each prayer within a meticulously prescribed time has always been an integral part of the devotional daily routine of Muslims.






**Qibla Direction**


The Qibla, also known as the Kaaba, the heavenly room, etc., is a cubic building, meaning 'cube', located in Grand Mosque in Mecca.


The Qur'an states that "Indeed the oldest mosque created for the world is that auspicious celestial house in Mecca, the guide of the world." It is the holiest shrine in Islam, and all believers must face its direction in prayer anywhere on earth.






**Zikr Ring**


It is a smart prayer ring that Muslims use it as a counting tool in Tasbih and Zikr. It is used in place of a string of 33 or 99 Muslim prayer beads and it has a nice solid look and is easier to wear.




When connected to the iQIBLA Life, it also provides five daily prayer reminders and a schedule for completing Tasbih counts.
